target_policy.numeric_score_gate: A method-task cell is numeric only when a runner or verified package emits that exact task target and metric.
target_policy.proxy_policy: Proxy scores are allowed only when the matrix marks them as proxy_scored and keeps the reason/source attached.
target_policy.scoreless_cell_policy: Unsupported and not-evaluated cells stay explicit in the public matrix instead of being hidden or backfilled with proxy model claims.
